title: Unary full faithfulness from product precomposition
statement: Let C, D and E be categories with independent object and Hom universes, and let L:C→D. Given a FullyFaithful structure for precomposition by L×L from functors D×D→E to functors C×C→E, construct a FullyFaithful structure for precomposition by L from functors D→E to functors C→E. Its inverse on natural transformations is obtained by extending along the first projection, applying the given inverse, and restricting along the diagonal. This construction requires no nonemptiness assumption on any category.

source.place: Tag 001C: full faithfulness on Hom sets. The projection/diagonal argument is the existing private unaryWhiskering construction of lean/Sheaf/Paper/IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems.lean.

proof.text: For faithfulness, extend an equality after unary precomposition to transformations between first-projection functors. Product full faithfulness makes these transformations equal. Evaluate on diagonal objects to recover the original unary transformation equality.

For fullness, extend a transformation after unary precomposition to the product by its first component. Lift it using the supplied product inverse and evaluate the lift on diagonal objects. Naturality on diagonal arrows gives naturality of the unary lift. Evaluating the product map-preimage equation on diagonal objects shows that unary precomposition of this lift is the original transformation.

Use this explicit lift as FullyFaithful.preimage. Its map-preimage equation is the preceding component calculation. Its preimage-map equation follows by unary faithfulness. All data is constructed from the supplied inverse and all laws are proved.

proof_origin.place: Projection/diagonal argument already formalized in IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems; extracted with an explicit inverse construction for compilation performance.
